'''Shrimp''' are consumable Items.

==''Obtainment''==
*25% chance for 1 - 5 to drop from any parasite while the Arrow [[Celestial Events|Celestial Event]] is active.

==''Usage''==
Shrimp restore two hunger (one full drumstick piece) when eaten and can also be fed to wolves to restore health.

They can also be fed to [[Assimilated Enderman|Assimilated Endermen]], which will turn their skin pale, their flesh red, and remove their jaw.

==Trivia==
*Shrimp are, like the Arrow itself, a reference to Voices of the Void, where they can also be eaten as food.
**The white texture given to Assimilated Endermen when they eat a Shrimp may also be a reference to the Arirals found in Voices of the Void, who have pale skin.
** The part of the tooltip, "The greatest delicacy in the multiverse," references the Arirals' love for Shrimp, which they claim is the "greatest delicacy in the universe."
